data: longmemeval_s_cleaned 500 questions, real pipeline candidates (top-12 merged), glm-5.3 teacher 0-10 relevance per (query, candidate) pair
evaluation: shipped CrossEncoderReranker (BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3) vs teacher on identical pairs; Kendall tau over per-query rankings + gold-in-top3 retention
verdict: NO-GO on student training: the local cross-encoder RETAINS gold in top-3 slightly BETTER than the teacher (195 vs 186, +1.8pp) despite modest rank correlation (tau 0.41). The teacher's ordering does not transfer an end-metric advantage on this benchmark's candidate sets, so Rank-DistiLLM GPU training buys no measurable gain. Distillation campaign CLOSED with evidence.
known_limitations: teacher scores are glm-5.3 self-judgments (single teacher, temp 0); gold-in-top3 uses 30-char gold substring; parser zero-pad bug (single-digit scores x10) was exactly invertible and normalized in evaluate; splitlines() unicode-boundary bug fixed to split('\n').
